title: Verify: Entry point and App render unit tests
summary: Unit tests for index.html, main.tsx mount and guard, and App render
description: Test the entry chain with react-dom/client mocked.
acceptance_criteria: main.tsx calls createRoot with #root and renders App
technical_constraints: Mock react-dom/client with vi.mock; no real server

steps.action:
Create file with '// @vitest-environment jsdom'. vi.mock('react-dom/client', () => ({ createRoot: vi.fn(() => ({ render: vi.fn() })) })). Test 1 reads index.html via readFileSync(join(process.cwd(),'index.html'),'utf8') and expects it to contain 'id="root"' and 'src="/src/main.tsx"', and existsSync of src/main.tsx true. Test 2: vi.resetModules, set document.body.innerHTML='
', await import('../src/main'), expect createRoot toHaveBeenCalledWith the #root element and the render mock toHaveBeenCalledOnce. Test 3: set body empty, vi.resetModules, expect(import('../src/main')).rejects.toThrow('Root element #root not found'). Test 4: render() and expect screen.getByRole('button',{name:'Begin'}) in the document.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/entry.test.tsx
